summary: Khanna co-sponsored the Block the Bombs Act and a measure to eliminate $3.3 billion in military aid to Israel, declaring “Zero Aid to Israel” in 2026. TrackAIPAC red-carded him in 2024 before endorsing him in June 2026; BAMC Action called his genocide recognition a “game changer.” Earlier votes standing with Israel against Iran and condemning “from the river to the sea,” plus his January 2026 Yea on the foreign-aid package he attributed to “snuck” provisions, mark a record in transition.
